title: Organization and membership
text: Hosted machine codes exist before organization choice. A signed-in member selects the organization; its engine owns authorization after scoped service handoff. Repeating that route is idempotent; another organization requires a fresh connection. Personal approval stays with the member. Team owns people, roles and email invites; Members retains seats and billing. Platform supplies authoritative inviter names; Platform users and engine actors are distinct identities. Source adoption is observed; changed Team consumer and production proof remain pending.
